subject: general
question: As of October 2020, who is the Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Nitin Jairam Gadkari.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Current transport minister is **Nitin Gadkari**.
 
• He is also famous for his work as the** Public Works Department Minister** of the State of Maharashtra.
 
• Nitin Gadkari was born into a Marathi family in Nagpur, India to **Jairam Gadkari and Bhanutai Gadkari** on **27 May 1957.**
 
• Through his teenage, he worked for the **Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha** and the student **union Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/904770872564c10e79889ae4df3528f164a33a71e65a0a3d1eb95d12f94483ab.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The current **Finance Minister **of India is **Nirmala Sitharaman.****​ **
 
• **Sushma Swaraj **was the first female **Spokesperson of a national political party in India.**
 
• **Piyush Goyal **is minister of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution (2020 – present).
